title: My Profiles

sections.addresses_desc: Add office and physical locations compatible with map applications.
sections.social_desc: Add your social media profiles and websites with automated icons.
sections.media_desc: Upload profile avatar and cover photos displayed on your digital card and vCard.
sections.settings_desc: Configure default language, publishing status, and primary card priority.

public_page.title: Public page
public_page.subtitle: This profile's public address and the sections visitors see.
public_page.disabled_hint: While off the address returns 404; cards and links do not open this profile.
public_page.username_hint: 3–40 characters: lowercase letters, digits and single . _ - between them. Renaming redirects the old address.
public_page.banks_hint: Only the ones you pick are shown. With none picked the bank section stays hidden.
public_page.banks_empty: This account has no bank accounts.
public_page.username_taken: This username is used by another profile, card or link.
public_page.read_only: Only account owners and admins can change the public page.
public_page.background_hint: Designs saved in the Background Studio and the gallery are listed here.
public_page.lead_capture_hint: Visitors can leave their name, email or phone and a message. You find them under Leads.
public_page.contact_exchange_hint: Visitors can share their own contact details or their ComCode profile with you. You find them under Leads.
public_page.theme_hint: Sets the colors, fonts and layout. A background you pick replaces the theme's default background.
completion.checklist_desc: Each step raises the completion score. Open a step to go straight to the right field.
completion.suggestions.name: Add both your first and last name
completion.suggestions.title: Add your job title
completion.suggestions.phone: Add a phone or WhatsApp number
completion.suggestions.address: Add an address with a city
completion.suggestions.social: Add a social media or website link
verification.title: Verified profile
verification.hint.none: Ask ComCode to verify this profile. Verified profiles show a badge next to the name on the public page.
verification.hint.pending: ComCode is reviewing this profile. You will get a notification when it is decided.
verification.hint.verified: The verified badge shows next to the name on the public page. Changing the name or organization sends the profile back to review.
verification.hint.rejected: The request was rejected. Update the profile and request again.
verification.re_review_notice: The name or organization changed after verification, so the badge was removed and the profile is back in review.
verification.note_placeholder: e.g. official company profile, link to company website
review.title: Profile verifications
review.subtitle: Approve or reject verified-badge requests. Approved profiles show the badge on their public page.
review.search_placeholder: Search name, organization, username or account
review.reject_desc: The owner sees this reason and can request again.
review.revoke_desc: The badge disappears from the public page right away. The owner sees this reason.
public_page.theme_premium_fallback: This theme is not included in your plan. Visitors see {{theme}} for now; your choice comes back when you upgrade.
public_page.background_premium_fallback: This background is animated and not included in your plan. Visitors see the theme's background for now; your choice comes back when you upgrade.
public_page.branding_locked: The company locked its branding: its theme, layout and cover are shown on this page instead of the choices here.
